delivery: One source-only submissions/<folder> module with tests and documented behavior; unchanged ABI/host; no GUI/devices.
review: Local host/Windows integration and review required even after kit tests pass.
name: VCF
behavior: Low-pass filter with separate 12dB/oct and24dB/oct output buffers to avoid inventing enum UI/mode-switch semantics.
Unpatched audio0; internal cutoff bounded to min(descriptor target,.45*sampleRate). Use shared5ms cutoff/resonance ramps, prepared coefficients/state and stable bounded algorithm.
Document exact resonance mapping and algorithm; do not claim Butterworth/analog equivalence without correct design and independent evidence.
Outputs raw; no hidden host output gain or arbitrary clipping to hide instability. Reset state to0 and snap parameter targets.
Include DESIGN.md source/derivation, response expectations and any resonance/input limits; advanced review before integration.
acceptance: DC/unity low-frequency gain at zero resonance after settling, impulse decay and expected far-from-cutoff 12/24 stopband slopes with justified tolerances.
Finite output at cutoff/resonance endpoints and alternating/ramped modulation for 44.1/48/96k; quiet tail/denormal handling.
Independent instances, state/reset, guards, variable spans; actual DLL two-output descriptor discovery.
